resources.string: In IBKR Client Portal, create an Activity Flex Query: XML format, Last Business Day, Open Positions with Summary level and all fields. Cash Report with Ending Cash and Ending Settled Cash is optional. Enable Flex Web Service, then enter your Token and Query ID.
Reports are read over HTTPS; nothing is traded and your ledger isn\'t uploaded. Credentials are kept in the device\'s secure storage, and the form is cleared when you submit, cancel or close it.
Cancelling; waiting for the current operation to settle
Fetching or saving a broker report; this may take several seconds

Linking calibrates the ledger account to the report\'s cash and replaces its opening balance for those currencies; securities are counted once, separately. Unlinking keeps the ledger account and the calibrations already written.
No available ledger account. Create an investment or bank account first. Wallets, cards, archived accounts and accounts already linked elsewhere are not offered.

Delete this local connection, cached snapshots and securely stored credentials? Ledger accounts and cash anchors remain. This does not revoke the broker Token. To replace expired credentials, disconnect and add a new connection; revoke the Token at the broker website.
Cancelled. Anything already saved stays saved; the snapshot was read again. Cancelling doesn\'t disconnect the broker.
Only the latest broker snapshot is retained. Ledger cash history is not a securities price or portfolio-value history.
No matching holdings in this report
Reported cash (negative values are margin debt)
The report contains no cash section; cash is not assumed to be zero.
Holdings come from your broker\'s report, not live prices, and update only when you refresh. Missing values stay unknown.
Valuation incomplete: missing reported value or exchange rate
Converted total unavailable; see original-currency values
Portfolio total combines accounts across currencies
Credentials rejected. Check the Token and Query ID.
Token expired. Generate a new Token, then disconnect and reconnect.
Broker restricted this source IP. Check the Flex service settings.
Query format rejected. Include Open Positions at Summary level.
Report not ready after polling. Try again later.
Broker request limit reached. Wait before refreshing.
Network request failed. Cached snapshots remain visible.
Report format rejected. The previous snapshot is retained.
Duplicate credentials or broker account. Review existing connections.
The input was rejected. Check the account and credentials.
The account is already linked or otherwise in use.
Connection or account no longer exists. Reload local data.
Local storage operation failed. Reload the cached state before retrying.
Device secure storage or platform operation failed.
Operation failed. No raw provider error is displayed; reload before retrying.
